summary: Let Y(σ) = ∑_{c,c'} ‖∑_t x(t)·amplitudeSum(𝖲ᶜ, c, ι_i(t)⁻¹σ, c')‖²/ν². Moving by an element of 𝖲 over (c, σ, p(c)) is a unitary change on the rows (a character times ⊗_v A_v), so Y(σ) = Y(1) for every σ in the reduced Bessel image S̄; and ∑_{σ∈S̄} Y(σ) ≤ energy(𝖲ᶜ, Ω_{i+1}) (convolution by the central idempotent x is a contraction) ≤ b⁻¹²𝖽₁ = b⁻¹²#S̄·columnDim. Hence Y(1) ≤ b⁻¹²columnDim, and Cauchy–Schwarz over the columnDim rows gives ∑‖row‖ ≤ √(columnDim·Y(1)) ≤ b⁻⁶columnDim ≤ b⁻⁴columnDim.
